decision.reason: [ev-e7ec4045554f] is a one-line release-note title that only links to PR #6490. It says XR and claim conditions now "persist observed generation", but not which field (for example a per-condition observedGeneration), what the behaviour was before or after, or whether anything is exposed or has a consequence. The PR description or diff, or a computed CRD schema diff, is needed to write the subject, change, applicability and consequence.
